definitions.explanation: Money earned from work, investments, or other sources, especially in a financial or tax context.

examples.japanese: {年間|ねんかん}{所得|しょとく}が{一定額|いっていがく}を{超|こ}えると{課税|かぜい}{対象|たいしょう}になる。
examples.english: If your annual income exceeds a certain amount, it becomes subject to taxation.

examples.japanese: {課税|かぜい}{所得|しょとく}を{計算|けいさん}する。
{所得|しょとく}{税|ぜい}の{申告|しんこく}をする。
examples.english: I file my income tax return.

notes:
{所得|しょとく} refers to income in a formal or financial context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所得税|しょとくぜい}: income tax
- {課税所得|かぜいしょとく}: taxable income
- {年間所得|ねんかんしょとく}: annual income
- {所得申告|しょとくしんこく}: income declaration
- {高所得|こうしょとく}: high income
- {低所得|ていしょとく}: low income

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {収入|しゅうにゅう}: income, revenue (more general)
- {給料|きゅうりょう}: salary, wages (specifically from employment)
